title: Record the pair-collision identity
body:
## Summary
- For every subset of `F_2^4` and every nonzero linear functional, `sum C(r_y, 2) = 2 * sum A_x B_x`.
- That is 65,536 subsets and 15 functionals, 983,040 checks.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged, and this check does not decide `f(7)`.
